title: The Twin Court Truth Canon
summary: A school canon of two courts that question a foe in turn and give their ruling together in the closing stroke of the school.

title: Canon of the Hawk and Mirror Truth
summary: A school canon in which the formed core is the mirror and the hawk's sight the lens and the whole shows a foe himself as he is.

title: The Plain Word Oath Canon
summary: A school canon of oaths spoken plainly with the field behind each word so that the word and the stroke are the same act.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Reckoning
summary: A school canon of reckoning held open from the formed core on a clear bearing that no lie can stand against.
